etymologies.etymologyHTML: Compound of net +‎ work.

definitions.definition: A fabric or structure of fibrous elements attached to each other at regular intervals.

quote.citation: 1911, James George Frazer, The Golden Bough, volume 9, page 287:
quote.text: He wore a mantle of network.

definitions.definition: A directory of people maintained for their advancement
(broadcasting) A group of affiliated television stations that broadcast common programs from a parent company.

quote.citation: 2008, Lou Schuler, "Foreward", in Nate Green, Built for Show, page xi
quote.text: TV back then was five channels (three networks, PBS, and an independent station that ran I Love Lucy reruns), […]

definitions.definition: (computing, Internet) Multiple computers and other devices connected together to share information
(intransitive) To interact socially for the purpose of getting connections or personal advancement.
(transitive) To connect two or more computers or other computerized devices.
(transitive) To interconnect a group or system.
(transitive, broadcasting) To broadcast across an entire network of stations and affiliates at the same time.
